# About the book {.unnumbered}

::: callout-warning
## This book is currently in its drafting stages and has not yet been published. Most of the chapters are incomplete and still undergoing further refinement.
:::

This book is designed for beginner and novice R users, with chapters structured sequentially to introduce R step-by-step, starting with foundational topics and progressing to more complex material.

Chapters 1 to 3 introduce readers to R and RStudio. For those already somewhat familiar with R, these chapters may seem straightforward and can be skipped without issue.

Chapters 4 and 5 provide essential knowledge on basic R coding, commonly used in data analysis projects. It is advised to read these chapters thoroughly before moving on, as they lay the groundwork for more advanced topics.

Chapter 6 introduces readers to basic knowledge in descriptive statistics. This chapter is significant for those who aim to further their journey in data analysis. It covers essential concepts such as measures of central tendency, variability, and relevant packages, providing a strong foundation for more advanced statistical techniques.

Chapter 7 focuses on basic visualizations and plotting techniques. Readers will learn how to use base R functions for visual representation and will be introduced to `ggplot2`, a highly regarded package for data visualisation in R.

Chapter 8 covers loop, apply family, and function, topics that may pose a challenge for beginners. This chapter aims to equip readers with the skills needed for more efficient R coding. While not critical for initial learning, understanding these concepts will become increasingly important as one progresses in data analysis.

Chapters 9 delve into essential skills for data exploration. Mastering these skills will enable readers to gain deeper insights into their data and prepare them for more advanced analysis techniques.

Chapter 10 explores the ethical use of AI in data analysis and coding, while highlighting the potential drawbacks of adopting these tools prematurely as a learner. By the end of the chapter, readers will understand how to strike the right balance—leveraging AI to boost productivity without sacrificing foundational mastery

Chapter 11 concludes the book by summarising previous content and offering guidance on next steps to further enhance R and data analysis skills.

Each chapter kicks off with a quote—I hope you enjoy it! To wrap things up, each chapter ends with chapter summary and revision questions.

Happy learning!
